confidence_notes: Medium overall: general-knowledge estimates, not live listings, projected to July 2026 from remembered prices with allowance for Malaysian price growth; USD conversions assume roughly RM 4.1-4.4 per USD. Restaurant anchors are the most reliable; accommodation varies widely by district and season, so room anchors carry the widest ranges. Cocktail and wine were set from the beer anchor (about 2.2x and 2.3x beer) because direct knowledge is weak; beer is a domestic draft or bottled equivalent. FX row: the 2026-10-15 figure came from search-surfaced RBA results; the page was not opened directly and cached copies disagreed.
comparable_city_reasoning: No specific comparable city or supplied city context was used. Basis is general knowledge: George Town restaurant and accommodation levels placed below Kuala Lumpur and in line with other Malaysian heritage tourism cities, with hostel and budget-hotel tiers set against typical Malaysian registered-accommodation rates.
